paragraphs.text: Vazi , known to be a Keen Negotiator , is a human advisor from New Capenna .

Vazi is a character that debut in New Capenna Commander as part of Set and Collector Boosters but not in any of the commander decks. She is a Riveteers negotiator. She wears a blend of practical leather and fine fabrics, adorned with subtle yet unmistakable symbols of her power - a small handaxe in one hand for threatening, and a bottle of halo in the other hand for tempting. She creates treasure for her opponents while then using that treasure to increase the power and toughness of her and her allies.
